title_en: ការកុម្ម៉ង់អាហារ និងភេសជ្ជៈ
subtitle: How to order coffee, ask about the menu, and pay politely
description: Essential English phrases for ordering coffee, lunch, or takeout: from entering the shop to asking about the menu and paying the bill. With native audio and Khmer meanings.

sections.en: នៅមុខបញ្ជរ
ការកុម្ម៉ង់
ការជ្រើសរើសជម្រើស

spine.title: Ordering Flow · របៀបកុម្ម៉ង់មួយជំហានម្តងៗ
spine.note: A clear flow: walk to the counter, state your order, customize options, and complete payment.

explain.title: At a glance · មើលមួយភ្លែត
explain.why: Ordering at a cafe is quick and polite. Use phrases like 'Can I please have...' and specify size or sweetness clearly.

cards.alt: A staff person behind a service counter
cards.ko: Hello! What can I get started for you today?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A standard greeting used by cafe staff to take your order.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ សួស្តី! តើខ្ញុំអាចជួយយកអ្វីជូនអ្នកថ្ងៃនេះដែរ?

cards.alt: An iced coffee cup with a straw
cards.ko: Can I please have an iced latte?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite way to order a cold coffee with milk and ice.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើខ្ញុំអាចសុំកាហ្វេឡាតេទឹកកកមួយកែវបានទេ?

cards.ko: I would also like a chocolate muffin, please.
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Polite phrasing to add a pastry or food item to your order.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំសុំនំប៉័ងសូកូឡាមួយដែរ សូមអរគុណ។

cards.alt: A sugar cube and sweetness symbol
cards.ko: Could you make that with less sugar, please?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Asking the barista to customize the sweetness level of your drink.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើអាចជួយធ្វើដោយដាក់ស្ករតិចបានទេ?

cards.ko: Is that for here or to go?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Asking if you will drink inside the cafe or take it away.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើអ្នកពិសារនៅទីនេះ ឬខ្ចប់ទៅក្រៅ?

💡 Meaning: Telling the cashier that you want your order packed in a takeaway cup.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ចប់ទៅក្រៅ សូមអរគុណ!

💡 Meaning: Asking for the final price of everything you ordered.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើសរុបទាំងអស់ថ្លៃប៉ុន្មានដែរ?

cards.ko: Can I pay by credit card?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Inquiring whether the shop accepts cashless card payments.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើខ្ញុំអាចទូទាត់តាមកាតឥណទានបានទេ?

qa.title: Polite Phrases · របៀបនិយាយឱ្យមានសុជីវធម៌

items.q: Why is 'Can I please have...' better than 'Give me...'?
items.qen: សំណួរ៖ ហេតុអ្វីបានជា 'Can I please have...' ល្អជាង 'Give me...'?
items.a: 'Can I please have' sounds friendly and polite, while 'Give me' can sound too direct or rude to staff.
items.aen:
💡 English: Adding 'please' and using 'can I have' makes customer interactions pleasant.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ 'Can I please have' ស្តាប់ទៅមានភាពរួសរាយ និងគួរសម ចំណែកឯ 'Give me' អាចស្តាប់ទៅរាងគំរោះគំរើយបន្តិចចំពោះបុគ្គលិក។
items.why: Politeness helps create a great mood between customer and staff.

qa.title: Useful Questions · សំណួរមានប្រយោជន៍

items.q: What is the Wi-Fi password here?
items.qen: សំណួរ៖ តើលេខកូដ Wi-Fi នៅទីនេះលេខប៉ុន្មានដែរ?
items.a: The password is on the bottom of your receipt.
items.aen:
💡 English: Cafes usually print the network code directly on customer receipts.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ លេខសម្ងាត់មាននៅផ្នែកខាងក្រោមនៃបង្កាន់ដៃរបស់អ្នក។

qa.title: Survival Lines · ឃ្លាពេលត្រូវការជំនួយ

items.ko: Could you please give me a minute to look at the menu?
items.en: 💡 English: Asking for more time to make a decision · 🇰🇭 តើអាចសុំពេលខ្ញុំមួយនាទីដើម្បីមើលម៉ឺនុយសិនបានទេ?
💡 English: Asking the barista for their personal or popular suggestion · 🇰🇭 តើអ្នកមានអ្វីណែនាំពិសេសនៅទីនេះទេ?

vocab.title: Drinks & Food · ភេសជ្ជៈ និងអាហារ

items.en: 💡 Brewed drink made from roasted coffee beans · 🇰🇭 កាហ្វេ
💡 A hot or iced drink made by steeping leaves · 🇰🇭 តែ
💡 Clear pure liquid essential for hydration · 🇰🇭 ទឹកបរិសុទ្ធ
💡 Food made of two slices of bread with filling · 🇰🇭 នំប៉័ងសាំងវិច

vocab.title: Sizes & Options · ទំហំ និងជម្រើស

items.en: 💡 The smallest beverage serving size · 🇰🇭 តូច
💡 The standard middle beverage size · 🇰🇭 មធ្យម
💡 The biggest beverage serving size · 🇰🇭 ធំ
💡 Drink prepared with reduced sweetness · 🇰🇭 ស្ករតិច

vocab.title: Payment · ការទូទាត់ប្រាក់

items.en: 💡 Printed statement of charges for goods/food · 🇰🇭 វិក្កយបត្រ
💡 Physical currency in banknotes or coins · 🇰🇭 ប្រាក់សុទ្ធ
💡 Plastic card used to make electronic payments · 🇰🇭 កាតឥណទាន
💡 Paper slip proving that payment was completed · 🇰🇭 បង្កាន់ដៃទទួលប្រាក់
